GO Pass

GO Pass: November

Tue, Nov 3, 2026, 10:00 AM → Tue, Dec 1, 2026, 10:00 AM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

November's monthly GO Pass (Nov 3 – Dec 1). Rank up by playing; the top prize is a Groudon encounter, and the free track includes PokéCoins.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Free track highlights

  • A Groudon encounter as the final reward (it can be shiny, but that's not guaranteed).
  • 400 PokéCoins, a Lucky Egg, Rare Candy XL and Stardust along the way.

Deluxe (paid, US$7.99)

  • 1,000 more PokéCoins (1,400 in total), a Super Incubator and extra encounters. A US$9.99 version also skips you ahead 10 ranks.

Milestone bonuses

  • More Candy from trades, bigger Gift limits, longer Daily Adventure Incense, and more Stardust and XP from hatching Eggs.

Tip

Claim everything you've unlocked by Dec 3 at 10 a.m. local time.
